security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan RTL, when the hart executes WRS.NTO (Wait on Reservation Set with No Timeout) or any unbounded-wait instruction other than WFI, the trcstate[1:0] signal to the trace encoder remains at 2'b00 instead of being driven to 2'b11. The hardware logic generating trcstate only decodes the WFI opcode as an unbounded-wait trigger, missing WRS.NTO and other Zawrs/Zicond unbounded-wait instructions. When the hart then clock-gates itself during the unbounded wait, the trace encoder has no opportunity to flush accrued partial-timestamp branch history, violating the spec requirement that 'any accrued branch history must be reported within a maximum time from the last packet in order to maintain timestamp integrity.' The resulting trace stream suffers irrecoverable timestamp corruption that the decoder cannot detect, because the encoder never emitted a 'trace paused due to unbounded wait' notification.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: MuxLookup(io.hart.wfi, ...) OR when(wfi) OR wfi_signal trcstate Mux that does not include WRS.NTO / Zawrs / unbounded-wait condition in the 2'b11 case arm
security_spec.summary: trcstate unbounded-wait encoding only covers WFI, missing WRS.NTO and other unbounded-wait instructions — silent trace-stream loss with timestamp corruption when clock is gated during non-WFI waits
